sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Hello, I’m Wang Xinyue, and I go by Millie.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn həˈləʊ, ˌaɪm wɑːŋ ʃɪn jweɪ, ænd ˌaɪ ˌgəʊ baɪ ˈmɪliː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She goes by the name of Lily.
sentences.ipa: /ˌʃiː ˈgəʊz baɪ ðə ˈneɪm ɒv ˈlɪliː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 He is always full of energy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌhiː ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈfʊl ɒv ˈenədʒiː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The room is full of toys.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 He is smart and always ready to help others.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˌhiː ɪz ˈsmɑːt ænd ˈɔːlweɪz ˈrediː tə ˈhelp ˈʌðəz./
sentences.meaning: 4他很聪明，随时准备帮助别人。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Lei Feng was always ready to help others.
sentences.ipa: /ˈleɪ wɒz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈrediː tə ˈhelp ˈʌðəz./
sentences.meaning: 雷锋随时准备帮助别人。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Are you ready to have lunch with me?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɑː juː ˈrediː tə hæv ˈlʌntʃ wɪð ˌmiː?/
sentences.meaning: 你准备好和我一起吃午饭了吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My classmates are all interested in music.
sentences.ipa: /ˌmaɪ ˈklɑːsmeɪts ɑː ˈɔːl ˈɪntrɪstɪd ɪn ˈmjuːzɪk./
sentences.meaning: 我的同学都对音乐感兴趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 Ms Lin, this is my classmate Simon.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 7 Sport helps me stay healthy and happy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsevən ˈspɔːt ˈhelps ˌmiː ˈsteɪ ˈhelθiː ænd ˈhæpiː./
sentences.meaning: 7运动帮助我保持健康和快乐。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Please stay polite all the time.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 8 I enjoy playing Chinese chess and ping-pong.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪt ˌaɪ ɪˈndʒɔɪ ˈpleɪɪŋ ˌtʃaɪˈniːz ˈtʃes ænd ˈpɪŋpɒŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢下中国象棋和乒乓球。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 He gets to see all kinds of things and learns a lot.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌhiː gets tə ˈsiː ˈɔːl ˈkaɪndz ɒv ˈθɪŋz ænd ˈlɜːnz ə ˈlɒt./
sentences.meaning: 他能看到各种各样的东西，学到很多东西。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We don’t get to visit the museum at this time.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈdəʊnt get tə ˈvɪzɪt ðə mjuːˈziːəm æt ðɪs ˈtaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 我们现在不能去参观博物馆。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: She enjoys listening to all kinds of music.
sentences.ipa: /ˌʃiː ɪˈndʒɔɪz ˈlɪsənɪŋ tʊ ˈɔːl ˈkaɪndz ɒv ˈmjuːzɪk./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 At home, he likes to take things apart and learn how they work.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌæt ˈhəʊm, hiː ˈlaɪks tə ˈteɪk ˈθɪŋz əˈpɑːt ænd ˈlɜːn ˌhaʊ ðeɪ ˈwɜːk./
sentences.meaning: 在家里，他喜欢把东西拆开，学习它们是如何工作的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I have a toy car and often take it apart.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ hæv ə ˈtɔɪ ˈkɑː ænd ˈɒfən ˈteɪk ɪt əˈpɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 我有一辆玩具车，经常把它拆开。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 He also goes on the internet to find answers to his endless questions.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌhiː ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈgəʊz ˌɒn ðiː ˈɪntənet tə ˈfaɪnd ˈɑːnsəz tə hɪz ˈendləs ˈkwestʃənz./
sentences.meaning: 3他还在互联网上寻找他无尽问题的答案。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Your answer to this question is not right.
sentences.ipa: /ˌjɔː ˈɑːnsə tə ðɪs ˈkwestʃən ɪz ˌnɒt ˈraɪt./
sentences.meaning: 你对这个问题的回答是不对的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Do you plan to join the Painting Club?
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˈduː juː ˈplæn tə ˈdʒɔɪn ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋ ˈklʌb?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They plan to arrive at the cinema after three.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeɪ ˈplæn tʊ əˈraɪv æt ðə ˈsɪnɪmə ˈɑːftə ˈθriː./
sentences.meaning: 他们计划三点后到达电影院。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.meaning: 让我们计划一次旅行吧！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 My favourite artist is Xu Beihong.
sentences.meaning: 5我最喜欢的艺术家是徐悲鸿。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 I want to become a designer.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ˌaɪ ˈwɒnt tə bɪˈkʌm ə dɪˈzaɪnə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 They’re the perfect places for us to study.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌðeə ðə ˈpɜːfɪkt ˈpleɪsɪz fɔː ˌʌs tə ˈstʌdiː./
sentences.meaning: 他们是我们学习的理想场所。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: place for sb to do sth

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The reading room is a great place for us to read.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈriːdɪŋ ˈruːm ɪz ə ˈgreɪt ˈpleɪs fɔː ˌʌs tə ˈriːd./
sentences.meaning: 阅览室是我们读书的好地方。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Can you see the students running there?
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌkæn juː ˈsiː ðə ˈstjuːdnts ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈðeə?/
sentences.meaning: 你能看到学生在那里跑步吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Can you hear the students singing next door?
sentences.ipa: /ˌkæn juː ˈhɪə ðə ˈstjuːdnts ˈsɪŋɪŋ ˈnekst ˈdɔː?/
sentences.meaning: 你能听到隔壁的学生唱歌吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Lots of exciting sports matches take place on it.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈlɒts ɒv ɪˈksaɪtɪŋ ˈspɔːts ˈmætʃɪz ˈteɪk ˈpleɪs ˌɒn ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3很多令人兴奋的体育比赛就可以了。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Students’ painting show takes place in the library.
sentences.ipa: /ˈstjuːdnts” ˈpeɪntɪŋ ˈʃəʊ ˈteɪks ˈpleɪs ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrəriː./
sentences.meaning: 学生绘画展在图书馆举行。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: one of the greatest Chinese astronauts
sentences.meaning: 中国最伟大的宇航员之一

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 You will find lots of books on different subjects there—thousands of them, in fact!
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˌjuː wɪl ˈfaɪnd ˈlɒts ɒv ˈbʊks ˌɒn ˈdɪfərənt ˈsʌbdʒekts ˈðeə—ˈθaʊzəndz ɒv ˌðem, ɪn ˈfækt!/
sentences.meaning: 你会在那里找到很多关于不同主题的书 → 事实上，成千上万的人！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I thought the question would be hard.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈθɔːt ðə ˈkwestʃən wʊd biː ˈhɑːd./
sentences.meaning: 我以为这个问题很难回答。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: In fact, it was very easy.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 You can borrow three books at a time.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ˌjuː kæn ˈbɒrəʊ ˈθriː ˈbʊks æt ə ˈtaɪm./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I can only answer one question at a time.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ kæn ˈəʊnliː ˈɑːnsə ˈwʌn ˈkwestʃən æt ə ˈtaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 我一次只能回答一个问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 7 There is a reading room with computers on the top floor.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsevən ˌðeə ɪz ə ˈriːdɪŋ ˈruːm wɪð kəˈmpjuːtəz ˌɒn ðə ˈtɒp ˈflɔː./
sentences.meaning: 7顶楼有一间带电脑的阅览室。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 8 What else do you like about our school?
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪt ˌwɒt ˈels ˈduː juː ˈlaɪk əˈbaʊt ˌaʊə ˈskuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 你还喜欢我们学校什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Where else do you want to go?
sentences.ipa: /ˌweə ˈels ˈduː juː ˈwɒnt tə ˌgəʊ?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Club activities are a good way for me to enjoy myself and make friends.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈklʌb æˈktɪvɪtiːz ɑː ə ˈgʊd ˈweɪ fɔː ˌmiː tʊ ɪˈndʒɔɪ maɪˈself ænd ˌmeɪk ˈfrendz./
sentences.meaning: 2俱乐部活动是我享受自己和交朋友的好方法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Students enjoy themselves in after-school activities.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Hope to hear from you soon.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈhəʊp tə ˈhɪə frɒm juː ˈsuːn./
sentences.meaning: 希望不久能收到你的来信。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I’m always happy to hear from you.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪm ˈɔːlweɪz ˈhæpiː tə ˈhɪə frɒm juː./
sentences.meaning: 我总是很高兴收到你的来信。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 Everybody tries their best to make things better.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˈevrɪbɒdiː ˈtraɪz ðeə ˈbest tə ˌmeɪk ˈθɪŋz ˈbetə./
sentences.meaning: 4每个人都尽力使事情变得更好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s try our best to finish this task.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlets ˈtraɪ ˌaʊə ˈbest tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɪs ˈtɑːsk./
sentences.meaning: 让我们尽力完成这项任务。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 In my class, we all work in groups and take turns to do different chores.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ɪn maɪ ˈklɑːs, wiː ˈɔːl ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈgruːps ænd ˈteɪk ˈtɜːnz tə ˈduː ˈdɪfərənt ˈtʃɔːz./
sentences.meaning: 5在我的班上，我们都分组工作，轮流做不同的家务。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We often take turns to answer the teacher’s questions.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈɒfən ˈteɪk ˈtɜːnz tʊ ˈɑːnsə ðə ˈtiːtʃəz ˈkwestʃənz./
sentences.meaning: 我们经常轮流回答老师的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 We each do something for our class and learn about teamwork through chores.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ˌwiː ˈiːtʃ ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔː ˌaʊə ˈklɑːs ænd ˈlɜːn əˈbaʊt ˈtiːmwɜːk θruː ˈtʃɔːz./
sentences.meaning: 6我们每个人都为我们的班级做一些事情，并通过家务学习团队合作。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can learn about the world through books.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː kæn ˈlɜːn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈwɜːld θruː ˈbʊks./
sentences.meaning: 我们可以通过书籍了解世界。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 A life without health is like a river without water.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ə ˈlaɪf wɪˈðaʊt ˈhelθ ɪz ˈlaɪk ə ˈrɪvə wɪˈðaʊt ˈwɔːtə./
sentences.meaning: 1没有健康的生命就像没有水的河流。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Milk is good for our bones.
sentences.meaning: 牛奶对我们的骨骼有益。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I get nine hours of sleep every night, so I am always full of energy.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌaɪ get ˈnaɪn ˈaʊəz ɒv ˈsliːp ˈevəriː ˈnaɪt, ˌsəʊ ˌaɪ əm ˈɔːlweɪz ˈfʊl ɒv ˈenədʒiː./
sentences.meaning: 3我每晚睡九个小时，所以我总是充满活力。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He gets only five hours of sleep/only sleeps for five hours a night.
sentences.ipa: /ˌhiː gets ˈəʊnliː ˈfaɪv ˈaʊəz ɒv ˈsliːˈpəʊnliː ˈsliːps fɔː ˈfaɪv ˈaʊəz ə ˈnaɪt./
sentences.meaning: 他只睡五个小时/每晚只睡五个小时。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 For lunch, I like fish, meat and tofu.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˌfɔː ˈlʌntʃ, ˌaɪ ˈlaɪk ˈfɪʃ, ˈmiːt ænd ˈtəʊfuː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I have a sweet tooth and it is hard for me to say no to cakes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˌaɪ hæv ə ˈswiːt ˈtuːθ ænd ɪt ɪz ˈhɑːd fɔː ˌmiː tə ˈseɪ ˈnəʊ tə ˈkeɪks./
sentences.meaning: 5我爱吃甜食，我很难对蛋糕说不。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I couldn’t say no to ice cream.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˌkʊdənt ˈseɪ ˈnəʊ tʊ ˈaɪs ˈkriːm./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want to say thanks to my teachers.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈwɒnt tə ˈseɪ ˈθæŋks tə maɪ ˈtiːtʃəz./
sentences.meaning: 我想对我的老师说声谢谢。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 I need to get enough sleep.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ˌaɪ ˈniːd tə get ɪˈnʌf ˈsliːp./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do you have enough time to exercise?
sentences.ipa: /ˈduː juː hæv ɪˈnʌf ˈtaɪm tʊ ˈeksəsaɪz?/
sentences.meaning: 你有足够的时间锻炼吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Dressing is a way of life.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈdresɪŋ ɪz ə ˈweɪ ɒv ˈlaɪf./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Which of the following is a way of helping each other?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɪtʃ ɒv ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ ɪz ə ˈweɪ ɒv ˈhelpɪŋ ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə?/
sentences.meaning: 以下哪一种是互相帮助的方法？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Well, it depends on the colour of our skin.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈwel, ɪt dɪˈpendz ˌɒn ðə ˈkʌlə ɒv ˌaʊə ˈskɪn./
sentences.meaning: 2嗯，这取决于我们皮肤的颜色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The price of the fruit depends on its size.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈpraɪs ɒv ðə ˈfruːt dɪˈpendz ˌɒn ɪts ˈsaɪz./
sentences.meaning: 水果的价格取决于它的大小。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The black skirt goes together with your yellow shirt.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈblæk ˈskɜːt ˈgəʊz təˈgeðə wɪð jɔː ˈjeləʊ ˈʃɜːt./
sentences.meaning: 黑色裙子和你的黄色衬衫搭配在一起。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 In fact, warm and cool colours make each other stand out, such as yellow and green or orange and blue.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ɪn ˈfækt, ˈwɔːm ænd ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz ˌmeɪk ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə ˈstænd ˈaʊt, ˈsʌtʃ æz ˈjeləʊ ænd ˈgriːn ɔː ˈɒrɪndʒ ænd ˈbluː./
sentences.meaning: 4事实上，温暖和凉爽的颜色使彼此脱颖而出，如黄色和绿色或橙色和蓝色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The young lady in red stands out in the team.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈjʌŋ ˈleɪdiː ɪn ˈred ˈstændz ˈaʊt ɪn ðə ˈtiːm./
sentences.meaning: 这位穿红衣服的年轻女士在队伍中脱颖而出。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 Some popular types are hanfu, qipao and tangzhuang.
sentences.meaning: 5一些受欢迎的类型是汉服，旗袍和唐庄。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 Qipao are usually made of silk, and they feel smooth and soft.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ɑː ˈjuːʒʊəliː ˌmeɪd ɒv ˈsɪlk, ænd ðeɪ ˈfiːl ˈsmuːð ænd ˈsɒft./
sentences.meaning: 6旗袍通常由丝绸制成，感觉光滑柔软。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: This bottle is made of glass.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 7 I think white shirts have a clean look, and white matches any other colour.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsevən ˌaɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈwaɪt ˈʃɜːts hæv ə ˈkliːn ˈlʊk, ænd ˈwaɪt ˈmætʃɪz ˈeniː ˈʌðə ˈkʌlə./
sentences.meaning: 我认为白衬衫看起来很干净，白色和其他颜色相匹配。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do you have any other questions?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 8 The jacket is not too long or too large, and it is dark blue.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪt ðə ˈdʒækɪt ɪz ˌnɒt ˈtuː ˈlɒŋ ɔː ˈtuː ˈlɑːdʒ, ænd ɪt ɪz ˈdɑːk ˈbluː./
sentences.meaning: 8外套不要太长或太大，呈深蓝色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Autumn in Nanjing is not cold or wet.
sentences.ipa: /ˈɔːtəm ɪn næˈndʒɪŋ ɪz ˌnɒt ˈkəʊld ɔː ˈwet./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 They’re a set of dolls in different sizes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌðeə ə ˈset ɒv ˈdɒlz ɪn ˈdɪfərənt ˈsaɪzɪz./
sentences.meaning: 2他们是一套不同尺寸的娃娃。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I bought a set of four chairs for my new house.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Onions are a symbol of good luck and health.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Giant pandas are a symbol of China.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdʒaɪənt ˈpændəz ɑː ə ˈsɪmbəl ɒv ˈtʃaɪnə./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 When the clock strikes 12, they jump off their chairs into the new year, in the hope of getting over any problem in the year ahead!
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌwen ðə ˈklɒk ˈstraɪks ˈtwelv, ðeɪ ˈdʒʌmp ˈɒf ðeə ˈtʃeəz ˈɪntuː ðə ˈnjuː ˈjɪə, ɪn ðə ˈhəʊp ɒv ˈgetɪŋ ˈəʊvə ˈeniː ˈprɒbləm ɪn ðə ˈjɪə əˈhed!/
sentences.meaning: 2时钟敲响12时，他们跳下椅子进入新的一年，希望在新的一年里克服任何问题！

sentences.text: I know how to get over the problem.

sentences.speaker: narrator
